A List of Method Parameters

Source: R/04f-ClassBenchConfig.R
MethodParamSet.Rd

Collects the method-specific arguments of a benchmark configuration. Each method registered in ScreenStrategy has a corresponding argument named "<method>_param", which defaults to list().

Usage

MethodParamSet(
  Scissor_param = list(),
  scAB_param = list(),
  scPAS_param = list(),
  scPP_param = list(),
  DEGAS_param = list(),
  DEGASv2_param = list(),
  LP_SGL_param = list(),
  PIPET_param = list(),
  SCIPAC_param = list(),
  SIDISH_param = list(),
  TiRank_param = list(),
  PhenoMapR_param = list(),
  ...
)

Arguments

Scissor_param

Extra arguments for method Scissor

scAB_param

Extra arguments for method scAB

scPAS_param

Extra arguments for method scPAS

scPP_param

Extra arguments for method scPP

DEGAS_param

Extra arguments for method DEGAS

DEGASv2_param

Extra arguments for method DEGASv2

LP_SGL_param

Extra arguments for method LP_SGL

PIPET_param

Extra arguments for method PIPET

SCIPAC_param

Extra arguments for method SCIPAC

SIDISH_param

Extra arguments for method SIDISH

TiRank_param

Extra arguments for method TiRank

PhenoMapR_param

Extra arguments for method PhenoMapR

...

Currently unused

Value

A modified list of method-specific parameters.

See also

Other ConfigSet: BenchGSEAConfigSet(), BenchGeneScoreConfigSet(), BenchMemoryConfigSet()

Examples

# \donttest{
MethodParamSet(
  Scissor_param = list(alpha = 0.05),
  scPAS_param = list(alpha = 0.05)
)
#> $Scissor_param
#> $Scissor_param$alpha
